summary: Unsettled start: low cloud on Sunday, then a north flow over the Alps from Monday to Wednesday with Bozen−Innsbruck down to −3 to −4.6 hPa (moderate north foehn index) and 700 hPa north wind of 30–50 km/h on Monday afternoon and Tuesday. The flow eases on Wednesday and Thursday (marginal) and Friday is the calmest day, with light SE–S winds and only a weak foehn index. The thermal profile was unavailable this run. Next week stays uncertain, with a 30–50 % chance of north flow on most days.

days.headline: Grey and humid, low cloud near take-off heights, gusts near 30 km/h, a moderate foehn index and a chance of light rain late on
days.foehn_text: Bozen−Innsbruck mean −2.2 hPa (ECMWF) / −2.4 hPa (ICON), dipping to −3.1/−3.6 hPa; Zurich−Lugano +4.1/+4.5 hPa. Moderate index, but no north flow and no dry air at Bassano (850 hPa RH 91–99 %), so no foehn signature on the south face.
days.text: Low cloud covers 70–90 % of the sky all day, with cloud base modelled around 1000–1600 m, close to or below the higher take-offs. 850 hPa air is near saturation (RH 91–99 %). Wind at launch height is light, 8–12 km/h from the SE, and 850 hPa is 8–12 km/h from SE–S, while 700 hPa blows W at 27–31 km/h. Plain gusts reach 25–32 km/h. Models disagree on the direction at launch height in the morning (spread over 90°) and on wind speed. A little rain is possible by 17:00. Thermals are likely weak under the cloud. The thermal profile is unavailable this run.
days.main_risk: Low cloud on the ridge and gusts up to ~32 km/h, with poor model agreement.

days.headline: Strong ENE wind in the morning (launch height 30–35 km/h, gusts over 50), then north wind at 700 hPa rising to ~40 km/h
days.foehn_text: Bozen−Innsbruck −3.2 hPa (ECMWF) / −4.4 hPa (ICON), extremes −3.5/−4.6; Zurich−Lugano +3.4/+4.8 hPa, up to +6.2. Moderate north foehn with north flow over Bassano, but the air stays moist (850 hPa RH 80–88 %), so not the full dry lee signature.
days.text: A strong ENE flow hits the plain in the morning: launch-height wind 30–35 km/h until midday, 850 hPa 25–32 km/h from the ENE and 10 m gusts of 43–54 km/h. From early afternoon the low-level wind drops, but the flow aloft turns north and strengthens: 700 hPa from 20 km/h at 09:00 to about 40 km/h from the N by 16:00–17:00. That puts the south face in the lee of the massif in the afternoon, with rotor and sudden gusts possible even if the breeze at launch looks light. Low cloud 40–65 % in the morning, clearing later. Models agree well on direction. The thermal profile is unavailable this run.
days.main_risk: Strong ENE wind and gusts over 50 km/h in the morning, then north flow aloft and lee turbulence in the afternoon.

days.headline: Strong north wind aloft, 43–50 km/h at 700 hPa all day; light southerly breeze below, typical lee setup
days.foehn_text: Bozen−Innsbruck −0.9 hPa (ECMWF, min −2.0) vs −2.3 hPa (ICON, min −3.1): models disagree. Zurich−Lugano +1.4/+2.2 hPa. North flow over Bassano with some warming at 850 hPa, but RH 71–84 %, so not the dry lee signature.
days.text: Mostly sunny, with some low cloud in the afternoon. The north wind at 700 hPa is 43–50 km/h all day, well above the limit for the north component. Below the ridge it is light: launch height 8 km/h from the SW, 850 hPa 8–11 km/h from WNW–W, and a 5–9 km/h southerly breeze on the plain. A light south breeze at launch under a strong north flow aloft is the classic lee picture: rotor and turbulence on the south face and gusts mixing down. Plain gusts up to ~35 km/h. ECMWF and ICON disagree on the foehn gradient. The thermal profile is unavailable this run.
days.main_risk: North wind of 43–50 km/h at 700 hPa above the massif: lee turbulence and rotor on the south face.

days.headline: Sunny and light at launch, but north wind of 22–29 km/h at 700 hPa and a moderate foehn index; the north component eases in the afternoon
days.foehn_text: Bozen−Innsbruck −3.1 hPa (ECMWF) / −2.9 hPa (ICON), extremes −3.7/−3.5; Zurich−Lugano +1.2/+2.2 hPa. Moderate north foehn with a weak north flow over Bassano; air not dry enough for the full lee signature (850 hPa RH 52–57 %).
days.text: Clear skies all day. Wind at launch height is very light (2–5 km/h, SW–W), 850 hPa turns from N 10 km/h in the morning to WSW 5–9 km/h in the afternoon. At 700 hPa the north wind is 28–29 km/h early, about 22 km/h around midday and 16–18 km/h by 15:00–16:00. Plain gusts 15–24 km/h, lowest late in the day. The moderate foehn index caps the day at marginal: a north flow aloft can mean lee turbulence on the south face even with a calm launch. The afternoon westerly suits Col Serai. The air is fairly dry and thermals may be weak; the thermal profile is unavailable this run.
days.main_risk: North flow aloft with a moderate foehn index: possible lee turbulence on the south face despite light wind at launch.

days.headline: Sunny with light winds below the ridge; north-west wind 20–28 km/h at 700 hPa and a weak foehn index
days.foehn_text: Bozen−Innsbruck −1.3 hPa (ECMWF, min −1.5) / −1.4 hPa (ICON, min −2.3); Zurich−Lugano +1.0 hPa. Weak index; ICON stronger than ECMWF. NNW flow at 700 hPa but moist (850 hPa RH 60–72 %), no lee signature.
days.text: Mostly sunny with no low cloud. Launch-height wind is very light (1–3 km/h, variable), 850 hPa 5–8 km/h from W–NW. At 700 hPa the wind is NNW at 22–28 km/h, with a north component of 20–25 km/h, increasing slowly through the afternoon; this is in the marginal range. Plain gusts 13–21 km/h. Light winds near the ground make the direction uncertain between models (large direction spread). Modelled cloud base around 1100–1700 m. The thermal profile is unavailable this run.
days.main_risk: North-west wind of 20–28 km/h at 700 hPa above the ridge, rising late in the afternoon.

days.headline: Light SE–S winds at all levels, part cloud, only a weak foehn index: the calmest day of the period
days.foehn_text: Bozen−Innsbruck −2.6 hPa (ECMWF) / −1.9 hPa (ICON), extremes −2.7/−2.0; Zurich−Lugano +2.2/+1.1 hPa. Weak index with no north flow and no dry air at Bassano: no foehn signature.
days.text: Light winds throughout: launch height 4–7 km/h from the ESE, 850 hPa 6–9 km/h from the E, and 700 hPa only 10–12 km/h from the NNW. Plain wind 4–7 km/h from the SSE, gusts 13–18 km/h. Low cloud increases from 15 % in the morning to 45–60 % in the afternoon, with cloud base modelled at about 1100–1700 m. Models disagree on wind speed in the morning, less so later. A SE–S breeze suits Stella Alpina, Tappeti and Camol. The thermal profile is unavailable this run, so thermal strength is uncertain.
days.main_risk: Afternoon cloud spreading over the ridge and a modelled cloud base close to the upper take-offs.

outlook.text: Light winds in the median (850 hPa 6 km/h, 700 hPa 16 km/h), 18 % rain chance, but 37 % of members show north flow and Bozen−Innsbruck median −3.2 hPa (range −6.2 to −0.7).
